observations: Brown or orange vertical gas cylinder.
The paint is glossy and thick with an 'orange peel' texture, indicating it has been recently repainted.
A protective metal shroud surrounds the valve area.
Standard brass valve assembly is visible at the top.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OLAMHI LEKAN' appears on both photos.
No legible brand markings, serial numbers, or capacity stamps are visible on the body or shroud.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not legible on any stamped markings in the provided photos.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or structurally compromised by rust hidden under the fresh paint.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the stamped manufacturing and expiry/test dates on the shroud.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve and neck joint.

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped markings on the handle/shroud showing the weight (kg) and the manufacturing/expiry date.
Video of a soap bubble leak test on the valve.
response.reason: The cylinder has been repainted, which is a significant risk factor as it can hide deep rust or expired safety dates. Verification of the stamped capacity and expiry date is required to ensure it is safe and legal for use.
